message: As a busy parent, I often find myself juggling a million things at once, but one small win that’s truly saved the day for me is having an emergency kit ready at home. It’s comforting to know that I have essential items organized and easily accessible, just in case we need them. If you haven't thought about it yet, now might be a great time to check out some simple ideas for putting together your own kit! What’s your go-to tip for being prepared?
